name: Sales & CRM Customer Lifecycle Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for sales and customer relationship management (CRM), covering B2B lead qualification (BANT), opportunity stage progression, proposal generation, pricing approval, territory management, sales commissions, customer onboarding, and lifecycle management.

checklists.name: Sales & CRM Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for lead qualification, opportunity stage progression, CPQ pricing approval, and customer onboarding.

items.statement: Leads are qualified against BANT criteria (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) before converting to opportunities.
Opportunity pipeline stages specify mandatory exit criteria and expected close dates.
Non-standard pricing and margin discounts receive Vice President or RevOps approval.
Customer contracts are executed via verifiable electronic signatures prior to deal closure.
Post-sale customer onboarding kickoff is completed within 5 business days of contract execution.

reviewGates.name: Revenue Operations Pipeline Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Revenue Operations Manager confirms that sales forecasts, pricing approvals, and account onboarding workflows satisfy business rules.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the sales pipeline documentation confirm forecast accuracy and pricing compliance?

obligationDefinitions.title: Stale CRM opportunities must be reviewed and dispositioned, not left open indefinitely
obligationDefinitions.description: An opportunity with no recorded activity past its stage's expected cycle time must be reviewed and dispositioned (advanced, disqualified, or explicitly reaffirmed), so pipeline reporting doesn't silently carry stale, unreliable data.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every opportunity flagged stale is dispositioned within the declared review cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: Stale opportunity disposition record
requiredEvidence.description: Disposition record for each opportunity flagged stale.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has every stale opportunity been reviewed and dispositioned?
